--- title: "Most rostered player-seasons log a stat line in some game, offensive linemen rarely do, and drafted players log one in more of their team's games" date: "2026-11-05" description: "Most rostered player-seasons from 2019 to 2025 log a stat line in at least one game, offensive linemen rarely do, and drafted player-seasons log one in a larger share of their team's games than the rest." followups: - "Measure snap counts or play participation for offensive linemen, the group the box score cannot show (issue 44 play-by-play)." - "Adjust the draftee comparison for depth-chart position and team quality, so the gap is not a difference in who gets the ball." - "Test whether a missing run of games in mid-season, for a regular, predicts a shortened career (issue 51)." author: - "AI directed by Nick Giangreco" freeze: auto vignette: > %\VignetteIndexEntry{Most rostered player-seasons log a stat line in some game, offensive linemen rarely do, and drafted players log one in more of their team's games} %\VignetteEngine{quarto::html} %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8} --- ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # ---- Packages, data connection and figure defaults ------------------------- # Load the project's functions straight from the checkout with pkgload; the # repo is never installed (decision 0042). The site build sets CFB2NFL_ROOT, # a local render finds the checkout from the working directory. root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT") if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path() knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root) pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE) con <- DBI::dbConnect( duckdb::duckdb(), file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"), read_only = TRUE ) library(DBI) library(dplyr) library(duckdb) library(ggiraph) library(ggplot2) library(knitr) # One interaction style for every girafe figure: a clear hover pop, dimming # of non-hovered marks, a dark tooltip, and toolbar zoom + PNG download. set_girafe_defaults( opts_hover = opts_hover( css = "stroke:#111827;stroke-width:2.5px;filter:brightness(1.12);" ), opts_hover_inv = opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.45;"), opts_tooltip = opts_tooltip( css = "background:#111827;color:#fff;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:bold;font-size:15px;" ), opts_zoom = opts_zoom(min = 1, max = 5), opts_toolbar = opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE, position = "topright"), opts_sizing = opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE) ) # thousands-separated and percent formatters for inline numbers fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) { formatC(as.numeric(x), big.mark = ",", format = "f", digits = digits) } pct <- function(x, digits = 1) sprintf("%.*f%%", digits, 100 * x) # ---- Named players (keyed on athlete id) ----------------------------------- # Key on athlete id, never name (recruiting ids collide, decision 0013). subjects <- tibble::tribble( ~who , ~cfb_athlete_id , "Joe Burrow" , "3915511" , "Jordan Travis" , "4360799" ) # ---- Load the tables ------------------------------------------------------- # Playing time is a contract-checked pipeline step, read from the targets # store rather than the DuckDB (decision 0041). usage <- targets::tar_read(player_usage, store = file.path(root, "_targets")) outcomes <- dbReadTable(con, "outcomes") # The population the post reasons about: rostered player-season-teams whose # team has a scheduled, completed game, in complete seasons 2019 to 2025 # (class year is recorded from 2019 on, and the 2026 season is still running). pop <- usage |> filter(on_roster, team_games > 0, season >= 2019L, season <= 2025L) pos_levels <- harmonized_position_levels() pop_pos <- pop |> filter(!is.na(position_group)) |> mutate(position_group = factor(position_group, pos_levels)) # Draft status is an outcome label, joined here and never on the table itself. # One team per player-season keeps a transfer's split games out of the rate. single_team <- pop |> group_by(playerId, season) |> filter(n() == 1L) |> ungroup() labels <- outcomes |> filter(draft_eligible %in% TRUE, !is.na(outcome_drafted_d)) |> transmute( playerId = as.character(playerId), season = as.integer(season), drafted = outcome_drafted_d %in% TRUE ) draft_pop <- single_team |> inner_join(labels, by = c("playerId", "season")) # ---- Numbers quoted in the prose: the whole population --------------------- # Every headline number below is computed here and reused in the prose. n_rows <- nrow(pop) share_any_all <- mean(pop$games_appeared > 0) share_any_pos <- pop_pos |> group_by(position_group) |> summarise(any_line = mean(games_appeared > 0), .groups = "drop") share_any_class <- pop |> filter(!is.na(class_year)) |> group_by(class_year) |> summarise(any_line = mean(games_appeared > 0), n = n(), .groups = "drop") ol_any <- share_any_pos$any_line[share_any_pos$position_group == "Offensive line"] # The other named groups: "Athlete" (a few dozen seasons) and unrecorded # positions are not compared. others_any <- share_any_pos$any_line[ !share_any_pos$position_group %in% c("Offensive line", "Athlete", "Position not recorded") ] class_any <- function(k) share_any_class$any_line[share_any_class$class_year == k] draft_summary <- draft_pop |> group_by(drafted) |> summarise( n = n(), any_line = mean(games_appeared > 0), mean_share = mean(appearance_rate), .groups = "drop" ) draft_by_pos <- draft_pop |> group_by(position_group, drafted) |> summarise(n = n(), mean_share = mean(appearance_rate), .groups = "drop") share_drafted <- draft_summary$mean_share[draft_summary$drafted] share_rest <- draft_summary$mean_share[!draft_summary$drafted] e1_holds <- share_any_all < 0.5 e2_holds <- share_drafted > share_rest # ---- Numbers quoted in the prose: the named players ------------------------ # Season rows for the recurring cast. cast <- usage |> filter(playerId %in% subjects$cfb_athlete_id, season >= 2019L) |> select(playerId, season, team, games_appeared, team_games) |> left_join(subjects, by = c("playerId" = "cfb_athlete_id")) |> arrange(who, season, team) burrow_2019 <- cast |> filter(who == "Joe Burrow", season == 2019L) travis_2019 <- cast |> filter(who == "Jordan Travis", season == 2019L) ``` ::: ::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"} *Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved 2026-11-07. The 2026 season is still in progress, so it is left out of the comparisons.* ::: ## 1. Introduction A box score is the only per-game record of who took the field, so a stat line is the signal this post uses. It asks how often rostered players log one, and whether drafted players log one more often than the rest. + *Expectation one: most rostered player-seasons log no stat line in any game.* + *Expectation two: drafted player-seasons log a stat line in a larger share of their team's games than other player-seasons.* ## 2. Data ### 2.1 A player with no stat line in a game is not thereby absent from it Each row is a rostered player-season-team, and a game counts as appeared when CFBD lists a stat line for the player in it. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} tibble::tribble( ~Term , ~Meaning , "Player-season-team" , "One player on one team in one season, from the roster or the game stats, from 2019 to 2025 on a scheduled team." , "Team games" , "Completed games the player's team played that season, postseason included." , "Appeared in a game" , "The player has at least one stat line in that game. Offensive linemen and many special teamers rarely log one, so this understates their play." , "Appearance rate" , "Games appeared divided by team games." , "Position group" , "The roster position for that season, in one of eleven shared groups." , "Drafted" , "Selected in the draft after that season, among seasons in which the player was draft-eligible and logged a season stat line." , "Class year" , "The player's eligibility class, 1 to 5, as CFBD records it; missing for some player-seasons, which are left out." ) |> kable(caption = "The terms used throughout.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: The terms used throughout. |Term |Meaning | |:------------------|:----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| |Player-season-team |One player on one team in one season, from the roster or the game stats, from 2019 to 2025 on a scheduled team. | |Team games |Completed games the player's team played that season, postseason included. | |Appeared in a game |The player has at least one stat line in that game. Offensive linemen and many special teamers rarely log one, so this understates their play. | |Appearance rate |Games appeared divided by team games. | |Position group |The roster position for that season, in one of eleven shared groups. | |Drafted |Selected in the draft after that season, among seasons in which the player was draft-eligible and logged a season stat line. | |Class year |The player's eligibility class, 1 to 5, as CFBD records it; missing for some player-seasons, which are left out. | ::: ::: ## 3. Results ### 3.1 Offensive linemen log a stat line in 7.8% of seasons, while the other groups log one in 54% to 74% *Expectation: most rostered player-seasons log no stat line in any game.* ❌ Out of every 100 rostered player-seasons, 57 log a stat line in at least one game, so most do; offensive linemen are the one group in which almost none do. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} by_pos <- pop_pos |> group_by(position_group) |> summarise( player_seasons = n(), any_line = mean(games_appeared > 0), median_share_if_any = median(appearance_rate[games_appeared > 0]), .groups = "drop" ) |> arrange(desc(any_line)) by_pos |> transmute( `Position group` = as.character(position_group), `Player-seasons` = fmt(player_seasons), `Logged a stat line in any game` = pct(any_line), `Typical (median) share of games, among those who logged one` = pct(median_share_if_any, 0) ) |> kable( align = "lrrr", caption = sprintf( "Rostered player-seasons, 2019 to 2025. Overall, %s logged a stat line; the rest logged none. Athlete and unrecorded positions are shown but not compared.", pct(share_any_all) ) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Rostered player-seasons, 2019 to 2025. Overall, 56.9% logged a stat line; the rest logged none. Athlete and unrecorded positions are shown but not compared. |Position group | Player-seasons| Logged a stat line in any game| Typical (median) share of games, among those who logged one| |:---------------------|--------------:|------------------------------:|-----------------------------------------------------------:| |Position not recorded | 5,178| 86.3%| 10%| |Running back | 12,022| 73.7%| 50%| |Defensive back | 28,465| 67.8%| 30%| |Linebacker | 19,281| 64.7%| 29%| |Defensive line | 23,088| 64.0%| 33%| |Quarterback | 7,503| 63.2%| 38%| |Receiver | 21,609| 62.5%| 50%| |Tight end | 9,635| 53.9%| 33%| |Special teams | 9,980| 53.9%| 62%| |Athlete | 30| 33.3%| 11%| |Offensive line | 22,292| 7.8%| 8%| ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} p <- by_pos |> mutate( label = reorder(as.character(position_group), any_line), tip = sprintf( "%s: %s of %s player-seasons logged a line", position_group, pct(any_line), fmt(player_seasons) ) ) |> ggplot(aes( x = any_line, y = label, fill = position_group == "Offensive line" )) + geom_col_interactive( aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = as.character(position_group)), show.legend = FALSE ) + scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "#9CA3AF", `TRUE` = "#B45309")) + scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + annotate( "text", x = ol_any + 0.02, y = 1, label = paste0( "Linemen log a line in ", pct(ol_any), " of seasons: the box score cannot show their play" ), hjust = 0, size = 4.5 ) + labs( x = "Share of rostered player-seasons with a stat line in at least one game", y = NULL ) + theme_minimal(base_size = 15) girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} by_season_pos <- pop_pos |> group_by(season, position_group) |> summarise(any_line = mean(games_appeared > 0), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |> mutate( tip = sprintf( "%s, %s: %s of %s logged a line", position_group, season, pct(any_line), fmt(n) ) ) p2 <- ggplot( by_season_pos, aes(season, any_line, colour = position_group, group = position_group) ) + geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) + geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(season, position_group)), size = 3) + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2019:2025) + scale_colour_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.9) + labs( x = "Season", y = "Share with a stat line in at least one game", colour = NULL ) + theme_minimal(base_size = 15) girafe(ggobj = p2, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### 3.2 Stat lines rise from the third class year on, from 42% of second-years to 69% of fourth-years The table and figures split the same population by class year, which is missing for some player-seasons and left out here. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} share_any_class |> transmute( `Class year` = as.character(class_year), `Player-seasons` = fmt(n), `Logged a stat line in any game` = pct(any_line) ) |> kable( align = "lrr", caption = "Rostered player-seasons by class year, 2019 to 2025 (class year 5 is small)." ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Rostered player-seasons by class year, 2019 to 2025 (class year 5 is small). |Class year | Player-seasons| Logged a stat line in any game| |:----------|--------------:|------------------------------:| |1 | 39,785| 41.8%| |2 | 18,704| 41.6%| |3 | 24,870| 50.8%| |4 | 67,338| 68.9%| |5 | 221| 76.0%| ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} p3 <- share_any_class |> mutate( tip = sprintf( "Class %s: %s of %s player-seasons logged a line", class_year, pct(any_line), fmt(n) ) ) |> ggplot(aes(x = factor(class_year), y = any_line, fill = class_year == 4L)) + geom_col_interactive( aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = as.character(class_year)), show.legend = FALSE ) + scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "#9CA3AF", `TRUE` = "#1D4ED8")) + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + labs(x = "Class year", y = "Share with a stat line in at least one game") + theme_minimal(base_size = 15) girafe(ggobj = p3, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} by_class_season <- pop |> filter(!is.na(class_year)) |> group_by(season, class_year) |> summarise(any_line = mean(games_appeared > 0), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |> mutate( tip = sprintf( "Class %s in %s: %s of %s logged a line", class_year, season, pct(any_line), fmt(n) ) ) p4 <- ggplot( by_class_season, aes(season, any_line, colour = factor(class_year), group = class_year) ) + geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) + geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(season, class_year)), size = 3) + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2019:2025) + scale_colour_viridis_d(option = "C", end = 0.9) + labs(x = "Season", y = "Share with a stat line in at least one game", colour = "Class year") + theme_minimal(base_size = 15) girafe(ggobj = p4, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### 3.3 Drafted player-seasons log a stat line in 84% of their team's games, against 52% for the rest *Expectation: drafted player-seasons log a stat line in a larger share of their team's games than other player-seasons.* ✅ Draft-eligible seasons count only players with a season stat line, so 100.0% of them have a line in some game and the comparison is the share of team games with one; Joe Burrow logged a line in 15 of LSU's 15 games in 2019, and Jordan Travis, a backup that year, in 4 of 13. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} draft_summary |> transmute( Group = if_else(drafted, "Drafted", "Not drafted"), `Player-seasons` = fmt(n), `Average (mean) share of team games with a line` = pct(mean_share) ) |> kable( align = "lrr", caption = "Draft-eligible player-seasons, 2019 to 2025, one team per player-season." ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Draft-eligible player-seasons, 2019 to 2025, one team per player-season. |Group | Player-seasons| Average (mean) share of team games with a line| |:-----------|--------------:|----------------------------------------------:| |Not drafted | 40,337| 52.3%| |Drafted | 1,266| 83.8%| ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} p5 <- draft_by_pos |> mutate( grp = if_else(drafted, "Drafted", "Not drafted"), tip = sprintf( "%s, %s: a line in %s of team games, on average over %s player-seasons", position_group, grp, pct(mean_share), fmt(n) ) ) |> ggplot(aes( x = mean_share, y = reorder(as.character(position_group), mean_share), fill = grp )) + geom_col_interactive( aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(position_group, grp)), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7 ) + scale_fill_manual(values = c(Drafted = "#B45309", `Not drafted` = "#9CA3AF")) + scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + labs( x = "Mean share of team games with a stat line", y = NULL, fill = NULL ) + theme_minimal(base_size = 15) girafe(ggobj = p5, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} p6 <- draft_pop |> filter(!is.na(class_year)) |> group_by(position_group, class_year, drafted) |> summarise(mean_share = mean(appearance_rate), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |> filter(n >= 10) |> mutate( grp = if_else(drafted, "Drafted", "Not drafted"), tip = sprintf( "%s, class %s, %s: a line in %s of team games, over %s player-seasons", position_group, class_year, grp, pct(mean_share), fmt(n) ) ) |> ggplot(aes(factor(class_year), mean_share, colour = grp)) + geom_point_interactive( aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(position_group, class_year, grp)), size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5) ) + facet_wrap(~position_group) + scale_colour_manual(values = c(Drafted = "#B45309", `Not drafted` = "#6B7280")) + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + labs(x = "Class year", y = "Mean share of team games with a stat line", colour = NULL) + theme_minimal(base_size = 13) girafe(ggobj = p6, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 8) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## 4. Summary Most rostered player-seasons log a stat line in some game, offensive linemen rarely do, and drafted player-seasons log one in more of their team's games. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} tibble::tribble( ~Expectation , ~Verdict , ~Evidence , "Most rostered player-seasons log no stat line in any game" , if (e1_holds) "✅" else "❌" , paste0(pct(1 - share_any_all), " logged none") , "Drafted player-seasons log a stat line in more of their games" , if (e2_holds) "✅" else "❌" , paste0(pct(share_drafted), " of games vs ", pct(share_rest), " for the rest") ) |> kable(caption = "Each expectation and what the data showed.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Each expectation and what the data showed. |Expectation |Verdict |Evidence | |:-------------------------------------------------------------|:-------|:------------------------------------| |Most rostered player-seasons log no stat line in any game |❌ |43.1% logged none | |Drafted player-seasons log a stat line in more of their games |✅ |83.8% of games vs 52.3% for the rest | ::: ::: ## 5. Discussion ::: {.callout-important} Drafted player-seasons log more stat lines, which reads as more usage in the box score, not as snaps played. The box score records players who touch the ball or make a tackle, so it cannot separate a lineman who played every snap from a reserve who never left the sideline. - Offensive linemen log a line in 7.8% of seasons, so the box score is silent on the position whatever their snaps. ::: Caveats: the draftee comparison is an association, not adjusted for team quality or depth chart. Offensive linemen and special teamers are under-recorded, so their rates are floors. The 2026 season is left out because it is still in progress. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE) ``` :::
